decisions.statement: A move keeps the name the page has.
A path the index files no page at is refused.
A page and every file that page keeps beside the page are moved together.
The page's own file is carried after every file the page keeps beside it.
A file is asked which bodies import it while the page owning it is still there.
Which files sit beside a page is read from the index rather than from the folder.
A file the page claims and the tree has no body at is passed over.
A file beside the page lands under its own name in the folder the page lands in.
A file beside the page under a TypeScript name is moved by `move-file-code`.
Every other file beside the page is moved by `move-file`.
A refusal from any change reached here refuses the whole move.
Nothing here changes the data the page states.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one page moved to another folder with every file that page keeps beside the page
